summary: AngloGold Ashanti filed a Form 6-K reporting Q1 2026 earnings and announcing a proposed $2.0bn share repurchase program and a record $585m interim dividend (116 cps). The buyback is subject to shareholder approval; no specific price per share or premium is stated. The company generated record free cash flow of $1.2bn and swung to net cash of $868m from net debt. The board approved the repurchase on May 7, 2026. Mechanically, the program targets ordinary shares. Watch for shareholder vote details and execution pace; the capital return signals strong balance sheet and management confidence in cash generation.
